## HubSpot Sales Hub: billing, seats and onboarding

HubSpot's free CRM is useful for a small starting setup, not a free ten-person sales team. Advanced sales features belong to paid editions, and Marketing Hub, Service Hub and Revenue Hub are not interchangeable with a Sales Hub seat.

| Edition | Published USD pricing | Budgeting context |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free CRM | $0 | Up to 2 users and 1,000 contacts; no expiration date |
| Starter | Promotional starting price $7/seat/month; $20 reference price displayed | Check promotion eligibility, billing period and renewal terms at checkout; not a permanent universal $7 tariff |
| Professional | From $90/seat/month billed annually; $100 with monthly payments and annual commitment | Sales automation and reporting; required one-time $1,500 onboarding is additional |
| Enterprise | From $150/seat/month | Advanced control and flexibility; required one-time $3,500 onboarding is additional; confirm contract terms with sales |

The official Sales Hub pricing page distinguishes payment cadence from contract commitment. Professional monthly payments do not mean a monthly-cancellable contract. HubSpot Credits and additional hubs can add costs; confirm the required seat types and package rather than reusing old two-, five- or ten-seat minimum assumptions.

...

## Salesforce Sales: the current edition ladder

The current public ladder is Free Suite, Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Core, Advanced and Max. The previous Enterprise $165, Unlimited $330 and Unlimited+ $500 rows are not the current public buying ladder. This is a packaging change, not a claim that each old edition maps one-to-one to a new name.

| Edition | USD/user/month | Billing and package |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free Suite | $0 | Free entry package; check its feature and user limits before planning a team rollout |
| Starter Suite | $25 | Billed monthly or annually; lead, contact and opportunity management with suite capabilities |
| Pro Suite | $100 | Billed annually; greater customization, automation, quoting and forecasting |
| Core | $195 | Billed annually; Sales Cloud package with built-in AI, Slack Business+ and Tableau Next |
| Advanced | $395 | Billed annually; enhanced security, additional AI and expanded data capacity |
| Max | $550 | Billed annually; expanded AI/product bundle including Agentforce and 2.75M Flex Credits per organization/year |

Use Salesforce's current Sales pricing and feature matrix for exact entitlements. Agent capabilities, support, credits and other bundled products vary by package. Do not claim all AI is an extra charge or all AI usage is unlimited. Implementation, administration and optional products should be budgeted separately; published list prices are not a negotiated quote.

## Pipedrive: Lite, Growth, Premium and Ultimate

The current new-customer ladder has four plans. Essential, Advanced, Professional, Power and Enterprise are legacy labels: use your existing account contract when reviewing a renewal, not this new-customer table as an automatic migration map.

| Plan | USD/seat/month billed annually | Annual base cost per seat | Main distinction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lite | $14 | $168 | Lead, calendar and pipeline management; AI report creation |
| Growth | $39 | $468 | Email sync, automations, nurturing sequences and forecast reports |
| Premium | $59 | $708 | Lead generation, scoring, AI email tools, contracts and enhanced customization |
| Ultimate | $79 | $948 | Additional security, enrichment, sandbox testing and extended phone support |

These are the USD annual-billing figures on Pipedrive's official pricing page, checked September 17. Monthly billing is a separate selector; do not estimate its rates with a blanket 20% uplift. The trial is 14 days, not a permanent free plan.

The official billing guide says subscriptions are charged per seat, including unassigned seats. Annual subscriptions are paid upfront. Add-ons and top-ups can increase cost: LeadBooster, Projects and Smart Docs are included in Premium/Ultimate, while Campaigns and Web Visitors remain additional across the ladder. Usage extensions have their own availability and limits. Currency and location also matter.
